zh: 一个整数是偶数，当且仅当它除以 2 的余数为 0。这一判断对负数和 0 同样适用：0 是偶数，负偶数也是偶数。
只需逐个检查数组中的每个元素，满足条件就计数。不需要排序或任何额外的数据结构；n 可能为 0，此时答案就是 0。
读入 n，再读入 n 个整数。计数器初始为 0，对每个 x 若 x mod 2 = 0 就加一（不要用“余数等于 1 才是奇数”的写法，负奇数在某些语言里余数是 −1）。最后输出计数器。
en: An integer is even exactly when its remainder modulo 2 is 0. This test also works for negative numbers and 0: 0 is even, and negative even numbers are even too.
Just check every element of the array and count those that satisfy the test. No sorting or extra data structure is needed; n can be 0, in which case the answer is 0.

Read n and then n integers. Start a counter at 0 and add one for each x with x mod 2 = 0 (avoid testing "remainder equals 1 means odd", since negative odd numbers give remainder -1 in some languages). Output the counter.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Traverse the input array and add one to the count whenever `x % 2 == 0`. This test holds for negative even numbers and 0 as well.

## Proof of Correctness

Each array element is checked exactly once, and a number is even if and only if its remainder when divided by 2 is 0. Therefore the counter ends up equal to exactly the number of even numbers in the array.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(1).
